notes: Built from the pinned release source with the listed patches and upstream's libretro Android CMake options, packaged as libazahar_libretro.so. Reports library_version 2126.2, as the official release core does. Core statically links its C++ runtime. No firmware, keys, NAND, game data or ROMs bundled. Clock resync ports the shared-page changes from martyfuhry/azahar clock-resync-v3 (45c7d2cdd), adapted to libretro resume and checkpoint loading.
